The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2960f958368ee0ab), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix a finite T > 0. The following conclusions hold for the flow of Theorem 3.1. (i) The function ρ is the minimal nonnegative solution with zero initial values of (∂t − Δht )ρ = trht Ric(g). (3.24) There are nonnegative smooth supercaloric functions ρj on M × [0, T] such that 0 ≤ ρj ≤ ρ, ρj ≥ ρ − Cj, ρj ⟶ 0 locally uniformly on M × [0, T]. (3.25) Each fixed ρj has all spatial and one-sided time derivatives smooth at t = 0 and bounded on compact spacetime sets. (ii) Suppose v is upper semicontinuous, bounded on compact spacetime sets, 0 ≤ v ≤ ρ, and satisfies, in the upper viscosity sense on 0 < t < T, ∂tv ≤ e−v Δht v + (1 − e−v )Rht . (3.26) Then v = 0 on M × [0, T). Neither assertion requires completeness of ht.
